title: orion-verify: warn about a commands-table row the project's CLAUDE.md lacks, and offer to add it
seam: orion.sh verify, tests/run.sh verify section, skills/orion-verify/
story: orion.sh verify used to flag only TBD and leftover starter placeholders, so a commands-table row that was never written went unnoticed. Now verify warns once per missing required row, matching labels loosely and skipping the table's header row; /orion-verify proposes the row with the command's source and adds it only on a yes, or offers to rename a label that is there under other wording.

checks.do: Run bash orion.sh init --project <tmp> --yes --no-statusline, delete the '| Test copies' line from <tmp>/CLAUDE.md, then run bash orion.sh verify --project <tmp>.
checks.expect: Exactly one 'WARN  claude-md-row' line naming orion's Test copies row and the word copies, ending 'verify: 0 fail', exit 0.

checks.do: In a fresh starter CLAUDE.md, change the commands table header to '| Type | Command |', delete the Typecheck / static analysis row, then run verify.
checks.expect: One claude-md-row warning naming the word type.

checks.do: In a fresh starter, relabel the rows to 'Run a single file', 'Whole test suite', 'Type checks' and 'Parallel copies', then run verify.
In a project missing the Lint row that has a lint script in its build file, run /orion-verify and answer Leave it.
checks.expect: One question naming the row, the command and the file and line it came from; CLAUDE.md is unchanged.
